verdict.rationale: Jira's own features page states that users can 'start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project,' which directly matches jumpstarting a new project from templates. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no detail on the template catalog or how setup works. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the template library and project-creation flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of template use.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates

citations.quote: Start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns.
